effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Coldharbour's Favorite appears when healing yourself or group members or when dealing damage, up to once every |cffffff10|r seconds. After |cffffff2|r seconds, he explodes on the target based on which event called him.

When healing, Coldharbour's Favorite heals for |cffffff4648|r Health over |cffffff6|r seconds, based on the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.

When damaging, Coldharbour's Favorite deals |cffffff2352|r Magic Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds, based on the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, and is a pet attack.
